metadata.title: Disclosed UAP Events Batch — August 2026 weekly curation (week 4)
metadata.description: Six officially disclosed PURSUE Release 05 cases not yet in the runtime catalog: Navy NPIC 1953 film analysis D098, FBI triangle/thermal FD-302s D028/D033/D037-D040/D026, and CENTCOM Middle East IR PR149.
metadata.source_scope: PURSUE Release 05 (2026-08-07) documents and DVIDS videos; official catalog text via war.gov/AARO/DVIDS
skipped: FBI-UAP-PR007 / D032 and CENTCOM PR134/PR136/PR024 plus Bagram D024 and Colorado Springs D030 remain in draft PR #5 — not re-promoted here
PR117–PR122 Oman clips already represented by gulf-of-oman-cold-orbs-2021
DOW-UAP-D099 ghost-rocket review (mostly meteor conclusion; deferred)
